description: QA for AI-drafted replies: captures the draft, what the agent sent, and the one-line reason, as a replayable case.
name: Overturn

parameters.helpText: Your Overturn API URL when self-hosting.
parameters.name: overturn_base_url

parameters.helpText: A project API key from Overturn (Settings - API keys).
parameters.name: overturn_api_key

parameters.helpText: Your Gorgias account subdomain, e.g. acme for acme.gorgias.com. The widget reads the ticket and its messages through the Gorgias REST API.
parameters.name: gorgias_account

parameters.helpText: A Gorgias API token with ticket read access, used as the bearer token for the REST calls.
parameters.name: gorgias_api_token

parameters.helpText: The workflow name. One regression suite per workflow.
parameters.name: agent

parameters.helpText: Which one-click reasons agents see when they change a draft. Defaults to the support pack on this surface.
parameters.name: reason_pack

parameters.helpText: Hold a changed reply's capture until the agent picks a reason (one click). A sidebar widget cannot stop the send itself; the capture is held instead, never posted reason-less.
parameters.name: require_reason

parameters.helpText: Also capture internal notes, not only public replies.
parameters.name: capture_internal_notes

parameters.helpText: Optional. Only tickets carrying this tag are watched; every other ticket is never captured. Without it, every ticket is watched once a draft exists.
parameters.name: scope_tag

parameters.helpText: Text pasted into the panel, at least this long, counts as the draft.
parameters.name: min_draft_chars
